cases.name: a rule carrying its trait reports the traceability up to date
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/hcm-{{SID}}
A=$R/src/{{PRODUCT}}.Application/Catalog/CreateProduct
T=$R/tests/{{PRODUCT}}.UnitTests/Catalog
mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks $A $T
cp .claude/hooks/handler-claude-md-check.sh $R/.claude/hooks/
printf 'readme\n' > $R/README.md
cat > $A/CreateProductCommandHandler.cs <<'CSEOF'
public sealed class CreateProductCommandHandler { }
CSEOF
cat > $A/CLAUDE.md <<'MDEOF'
# CreateProduct — create a product

## Règles métier

| ID | Règle | Exception / Résultat |
|----|-------|----------------------|
| RM-01 | The name is unique in the catalog | ProductNameAlreadyUsed |

## Flux

1. Load the catalog, create the product, save.

## Événements émis

- ProductCreated
MDEOF
cat > $T/CreateProductCommandHandlerTests.cs <<'CSEOF'
public sealed class CreateProductCommandHandlerTests
{
    [Fact]
    [Trait("RM", "CreateProduct/RM-01")]
    public async Task Rejects_a_name_already_used()
    {
    }
}
CSEOF
printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"'$T/CreateProductCommandHandlerTests.cs'"}}' | bash $R/.claude/hooks/handler-claude-md-check.sh
